blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — While they will adhere to the Supreme Court (SC) order asking them to comment on a petition against the impeachment court’s decision allowing a lower minimum number of votes for conviction, two prosecutors believe such talks are premature due to the lack of a justiciable issue. In separate online interviews on Friday, lead public prosecutor and Batangas Rep. Gerville Luistro and counsel for the prosecution, Benjamin Tolosa Jr., said there is no injury yet that the petitions from Senators Robinhood Padilla and Christopher “Bong” Go would cure.
